meta.name: Where the Mask Ends
meta.description: An ambitious street urchin seizes the chance to impersonate a noblewoman, and becomes the bride of a wounded war hero who seems sure to die.  But when her comatose husband awakens, she must navigate deadly schemes, win his heart through cunning, and uncover her royal heritage to triumph over rivals and rise from gutter to glory.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After discovering her lookalike, cruel heiress Wei Rao conspires to use the woman as a pawn when a sudden crisis forces an unwanted marriage.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A-Chou agrees to marry Lu Zhuo in Wei Rao's place, but she warns her mother about the Wei family. Meanwhile, the true heiress takes on the name Jundai.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After refusing to leave, the impostor Wei Rao makes a painful sacrifice to win Lu Zhuo's trust. Meanwhile, a calculated plot begins to unfold.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Wei Rao's maid helps her with a cover-up after Lu Zhuo nearly learns a lethal secret. A customary visit to the Wei family leads to a deadly setup.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: After surviving a library fire, Wei Rao attempts to hide a secret letter. Lu Zhuo grows suspicious when he notices the calluses on her hands.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Wei Rao wins praise for organizing a grand birthday banquet. Meanwhile, danger circles her compound as Lu Zhuo hatches a secret scheme using butterflies.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: While performing at the banquet, Wei Rao faces hidden threats from all sides, but her sharp wits turn a dangerous trap back on her enemies.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Driven by jealousy, Lu Zhuo makes a pact with Wei Rao. Meanwhile, Wei Rao's long-sought reunion with her brother draws dangerous attention from Han Liao.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A ruthless rival corners Wei Rao into a desperate bluff, leaving her dependent on a risky co-conspirator to keep her past safely buried.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Wei Rao turns an imperial order into a humiliation for Han Liao, but a symbolic act of defiance leaves her isolated when rebel soldiers strike.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Facing grave danger from court elites, Wei Rao receives crucial aid from Lu Zhuo, but a sudden imperial summons puts her secret in jeopardy.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Facing a deadly ultimatum from Consort Li, Wei Rao stalls for time while her rivals resort to murder and Han Liao incites civil unrest.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: As Wei Rao's generosity earns favor across the capital, Han Liao turns violent against his wife. Lu Zhuo appoints new commanders to train the troops.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: After uncovering dark secrets through a staged fire, Wei Rao exposes a household spy to the matriarch – sending her panicked rivals straight to Lady Guo.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Jundai's false testimony and forged relics turn the imperial court against Wei Rao, leaving her vulnerable when orders force Lu Zhuo to leave.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: A chaotic banquet explodes into a storm of accusations, forcing long-buried lies into the open and leaving a devastated Wei Rao to face the fallout.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: As dark fates claim her enemies, a cold confrontation with Consort Li leaves Wei Rao with one final demand — and an imperial grant of divorce.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Newly independent, Wei Rao takes in refugees while a desperate Han Liao seeks her favor, only for a family illness to reignite old household feuds.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Imperial schemes force a martial contest for Wei Rao's hand, driving an injured Lu Zhuo to fight Han Liao — but victory carries a tragic price.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Fueled by loss, a vengeful Wei Rao turns down a safe sanctuary, but mysterious deaths at the estate leave her household open to hostile rivals.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: The Han family's hidden fortune comes to light as Wei Rao gains an unlikely ally. Han Liao frames her, but new evidence threatens to expose his crimes.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: A royal exile throws the court into turmoil. Meanwhile, Wei Rao attends a grand banquet as evidence builds to expose a string of estate abductions.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Wei Rao uncovers a hidden courtyard of captives inside the estate. With Lu Zhuo creating a diversion, she leads a daring raid to set them free.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: While a fallen prince faces punishment, Wei Rao deflects palace scrutiny as marriage schemes and secret alliances threaten her future with Lu Zhuo.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: A solar eclipse draws Wei Rao and Lu Zhuo closer, but a grim discovery from Wei's past — and a hostile warning at a spring banquet — threaten her future.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Palace demands test Wei Rao's resolve, but a sudden epidemic near the estate forces a frantic race to secure the gates before panic takes hold.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: As hidden treachery infects her home, imperial rivals weaponize false claims against Wei Rao to orchestrate a cruel public humiliation.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Widespread unrest send the royal family fleeing, giving Wei Rao a sudden opening to challenge her enemies in a dangerous game of leverage.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Border unrest draws Lu Zhuo into a deadly ambush, while a rebel force storms Zhuyu Estate — forcing Wei Rao to make a last stand at the palace.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Locked in a fatal trap with her sworn rival, Wei Rao risks everything for a final reckoning, but will her sacrifices be enough to save the capital?
